cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

mechanism: A uses professional rank distinctions to burden a subordinate with plumbing supervision, treating promotion as a more qualified subordinate duty rather than escape.
confusable: D49 recruits help as deputy; D53 specifically transfers unwanted responsibility downward through hierarchy.
comparison: Inspector alternative delegates accountability and hearing attendance; sink alternative converts promotion into after-hours maintenance duty.
seedUse: Junior/senior coordinator, plumber and locking up derive from D53-a; S03 corrects promotion and security scope.
